qualification: No stability, thermal, USB compliance, EMC, or hardware qualification. No SPICE, no bench measurement, no effective-capacitance qualification. All numbers are conditional on the stated assumptions.

tps25947.dvdt_series_resistor_recommendation: 100 ohm in series with C_dVdt for C_dVdt > 10 nF

sk6805.note: No SK6805 datasheet is present in this repository. 5 mA/channel is an explicit assumption used for the full-white estimate; the sensitivity table covers 0.5, 1, 2, 5 and 12 mA/channel. Replace the assumption with the exact LED datasheet before treating the full-white number as a specification.

input_capacitance.verdict: BELOW_TI_TYPICAL_GUIDANCE_NOT_PROVEN_INSTABILITY. 5.8 uF nominal is 58% of TI's 10 uF typical recommendation; the assumed 0.92 derating gives 5.336 uF effective (53.4%). This is a review flag, not a measured failure and not a stability result.

inrush.efuse_response: The dV/dt-controlled capacitor current is far below the 425 mA minimum ILIM, so the eFuse does not current-limit the capacitor alone. The 400 us current-limit response and 500 ns fast-trip are not expected to act on this ramp. Active buck/LED load current is additional and is not included.
inrush.verdict: Capacitor-only inrush is ~1.16 mA at 5.8 uF and 0.2 V/ms, ~0.23% of the 500 mA USB descriptor and ~0.27% of the 425 mA eFuse minimum. Inrush is not the limiting compliance issue; steady-state LED load is.

uvlo_ovlo.verdict: UVLO rising is ~3.99 V nominal (3.86-4.13 V with resistor, reference and leakage sensitivity). That is above the buck's 3.8 V recommended minimum but below the 4.30 V no-foldback ideal and at/below the 4.08 V 98%-duty ideal at the nominal/min corners. The 4 V rail may rely on frequency foldback at UVLO release. OVLO rising is ~5.74 V nominal; the min corner with leakage is ~5.59 V, only ~89 mV above the 5.5 V USB maximum. Both are review flags, not measured failures.

existing_conservative_screen.note: The existing calculations.json used 4.41/6.63 uA, slightly wider than the datasheet 4.5/6.5 uA. Both are analysis screens, not measured startup times.

soft_start.verdict: Nominal SS reference ramp is 14.545 ms; the datasheet-limit 8 corners span 11.077-19.556 ms. The existing conservative screen spans 10.855-19.947 ms. This is the SS reference ramp, not the observed board startup, and it excludes capacitor derating, the eFuse ramp and load dynamics.

led_limiter.verdict: R112 = 133 kohm 1% sets 173.657/201.513/233.901 mA (min/nom/max) using the TPS2553 datasheet equations and the resistor tolerance. At the stated 5 mA/channel assumption, 76 SK6805 LEDs at full white draw 1.14 A, 4.87-6.56x the limiter. The TPS2553-1 is a latch-off part, so a full-white attempt is expected to latch the LED rail off, not merely dim it. The eFuse 500 mA nominal is also below 1.14 A. Full-white capability is not supported by this power tree.

order: U7 TPS2553-1 switch -> +4V_LED (enabled by GPIO22 through R109)

timing.ldo_3v3_startup_ms: unknown; MAX38902 BYP/soft-start not measured here
timing.led_rail_enable: firmware-controlled after boot; R109 100k pulls EN low at reset

sequencing.verdict: The netlist order is VBUS -> FUSED -> PROTECTED -> 4V -> 3V3 -> LED rail. The eFuse 25 ms ramp and the buck 14.5 ms SS overlap: the buck starts at the eFuse UVLO release (~20 ms) while the input is still ramping. The 4 V rail may not be monotonic. The LED rail is last and is held off by R109 until firmware drives GPIO22. Measure the actual rail order and monotonicity.

findings.title: Input capacitance is below TI's 10 uF typical guidance
findings.detail: 5.8 uF nominal (1 uF + 100 nF + 4.7 uF) and 5.336 uF effective at 5 V under the stated 0.92 derating. This is 58%/53% of the 10 uF typical recommendation. It is not a proven instability.

findings.title: UVLO release is below the 4 V buck's no-foldback input
findings.detail: UVLO rising ~3.99 V nominal vs 4.30 V no-foldback ideal and 4.08 V 98%-duty ideal. The 4 V rail may rely on frequency foldback at startup.

findings.title: OVLO min corner is close to the 5.5 V USB maximum
findings.detail: OVLO rising ~5.74 V nominal; ~5.59 V at the min corner with 0.1% resistors, reference tolerance and 0.1 uA leakage. That is ~89 mV above 5.5 V.

findings.title: LED rail limiter cannot support 76 LEDs at full white
findings.detail: 173.657/201.513/233.901 mA vs 1.14 A at 5 mA/channel. The TPS2553-1 latches off on overcurrent. The eFuse 500 mA nominal is also below 1.14 A.

findings.title: eFuse ILIM min is below the 500 mA USB descriptor
findings.detail: R124 = 6.65 kohm gives 425/500/575 mA. The 425 mA minimum is 15% below the 500 mA descriptor, so the board cannot guarantee 500 mA. The LED rail plus MCU/load must stay below 425 mA.

findings.title: eFuse ramp and buck soft-start overlap
findings.detail: The eFuse 0.2 V/ms ramp takes 25 ms to 5 V; the buck SS is 14.5 ms and starts at the ~20 ms UVLO release. The 4 V rail may not be monotonic.

unknowns: Exact C126/C136/C137 MPNs, dielectrics and DC-bias curves; the 0.92 derating is an assumption.
Actual VBUS source/cable impedance and input ramp/dip waveform.
Actual SK6805 per-channel current; 5 mA is an assumption, not a datasheet fact in this repo.
Actual MCU, flash, logic and LED load currents and their simultaneity.
TPS62932 loop stability, phase margin, load-step response and frequency-foldback behavior on this board.
TPS259470 thermal/current-limit behavior and actual trip point on this board.
MAX38902 dropout, startup and thermal behavior at the actual 3V3 load.
Firmware LED brightness cap, fault handling and latch-off recovery.
Whether the 4 V rail is monotonic through the eFuse/buck overlap.
bench_measurements: VBUS, VBUS_FUSED, VBUS_PROTECTED_RAW, +4V_REG, +3V3 and +4V_LED startup at 5.0 V and 5.5 V, hot and cold, with the actual cable.
Input ripple at U18 VIN at no load, MCU load and LED full-white attempt.
UVLO/OVLO trip points by sweeping VBUS up and down on the assembled board.
LED rail current and U7 FAULT/latch behavior at full white and at the intended firmware brightness cap.
3V3 load step and LDO thermal at the actual load.
Buck load step and, if stability is to be claimed, loop gain/phase across the application corners.
eFuse current limit and thermal at 425/500/575 mA.
Soft-start time and monotonicity of the 4 V rail.

recommendation.detail: Add a 5.6 uF/50 V X7R (or 6.8 uF) on VBUS_PROTECTED_RAW to reach >=10 uF effective at 5 V under the stated 0.92 derating. This is a margin improvement, not a stability proof. If board space is tight, measure the existing 5.8 uF first; the analysis does not show that 5.8 uF fails.
recommendation.led: Do not claim full-white LED capability. Either enforce a firmware brightness cap of <=0.76 mA/channel at the min limiter corner, or change the LED rail current limit and the USB power source. The current R112 = 133 kohm cannot pass 1.14 A.
recommendation.uvlo: If the 4 V rail must be regulated at startup, raise the UVLO rising threshold above ~4.3 V (e.g. 4.5 V) by changing R122/R123, and re-check the OVLO margin.
recommendation.measure_first: Measure the actual startup, input ripple, UVLO/OVLO trip points and LED rail current before changing the board. The analysis identifies margins; it does not prove a failure.
